run_GTestJsonOutputUnitTest: run the GTestJsonOutputUnitTest test suite to verify Google Test JSON output functionality
test_non_empty_json_output: test that a Google Test binary with passing and failing tests produces correct non-empty JSON output
test_empty_json_output: test that a Google Test binary with no tests produces an empty JSON output document
test_timestamp_value: test that the timestamp attribute in Google Test JSON output is a valid ISO datetime string
test_filtered_json_output: test that applying a gtest_filter flag produces JSON output containing only the filtered tests
